title: Success rate gain with truncated-bar-axis bait
what: honest regional success-rate gain (~1.2 pp, from 97.4% to 98.6%) without truncated bars

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: v4.2 lifts request success rate by +1.2 pp on average (97.4% to 98.6%).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; with >300k requests per region, the +1.1 to +1.3 pp gain is consistent across all four regions.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Truncated bars from 90–100% would distort visual proportions; dot/slope encoding or failure-rate framing stays honest.
